properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Harold M. Bixby to his wife, Debby Bixby, dated Friday, October 27, [1933], on stationery from the Manila Hotel; includes brief description of meetings with Governor General [Frank Murphy] and Senator [Manuel] Quezon, negotiations for franchise to fly passengers to Hong Kong; mentions Norman Hill, [William] Grooch and [William L.] Bond.
